statement: You are given an integer array nums. The range of a subarray is its largest element minus its smallest element.
Consider every contiguous subarray of nums and add up their ranges.

examples.explanation: The single elements have range 0, [1, 2] and [2, 3] have range 1 each, and [1, 2, 3] has range 2, so the total is 4.
The sum of all subarray maximums is 49 and the sum of all subarray minimums is 1, so the ranges add up to 49 − 1 = 48.
